result.instructions: Tools for fitDEGREE, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which classes are on the schedule at our Brooklyn studio tomorrow, and how many spots are left?"; "Show the bookings for the 6pm spin class on Friday."; "Which members bought a pass in the last 30 days?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes fitDEGREE data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fitdegree_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fitdegree_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fitdegree_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. fitdegree_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fitdegree_get_account
tools.title: Get the connected account
tools.description: Return the fitDEGREE account behind the API key: type (fitspot or company), identifier and label. Good first call to check the connection. API: GET /v1/me.

tools.name: fitdegree_list_fitspots
tools.title: List fitspots
tools.description: List the studio locations (fitspots) the key can see: id, name, company. Use the ids in the other list tools. API: GET /v1/fitspots.

company_id.description: Only fitspots of this company id.

updated_after.description: Only fitspots updated at or after this datetime.

updated_before.description: Only fitspots updated at or before this datetime.

tools.name: fitdegree_list_classes
tools.title: List classes
tools.description: List the classes (the studio's class definitions, for example a yoga or spin class) with their class group. API: GET /v1/classes.

group_id.description: Only classes of this class group id.

updated_after.description: Only classes updated at or after this datetime.

updated_before.description: Only classes updated at or before this datetime.

tools.name: fitdegree_list_registrables
tools.title: List bookable sessions
tools.description: List the bookable sessions (registrables): one scheduled class at a studio, with start and end time, cancellation flag and class id. Use it for the schedule and for free spots. API: GET /v1/registrables.

fitspot_id.description: Only sessions at this fitspot id.

class_id.description: Only sessions of this class id.

is_cancelled.description: true = cancelled sessions only; false = active sessions only.

starts_after.description: Only sessions starting at or after this datetime.

starts_before.description: Only sessions starting at or before this datetime.

ends_after.description: Only sessions ending at or after this datetime.

ends_before.description: Only sessions ending at or before this datetime.

tools.name: fitdegree_list_registrations
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List the bookings (registrations): which member is booked on which bookable session, and the status. Cursor pagination is available: pass next_cursor back as cursor. API: GET /v1/registrations.

user_ids.description: Only bookings of these member ids (max 100).

registrable_ids.description: Only bookings on these session ids (max 100).

status.description: Only bookings with this status (as the API defines it).

updated_after.description: Only bookings updated at or after this datetime.

updated_before.description: Only bookings updated at or before this datetime.

created_after.description: Only bookings created at or after this datetime.

created_before.description: Only bookings created at or before this datetime.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page. Send an empty string for the first cursor page; omit it to page by page number.

tools.name: fitdegree_list_users
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List the studio's members (users): name and contact fields as the API returns them, and their fitspot. Cursor pagination is available: pass next_cursor back as cursor. API: GET /v1/users.

fitspot_id.description: Only members of this fitspot id.

updated_after.description: Only members updated at or after this datetime.

updated_before.description: Only members updated at or before this datetime.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page. Send an empty string for the first cursor page; omit it to page by page number.

tools.name: fitdegree_list_sales
tools.title: List sales
tools.description: List the sales (purchases of memberships, passes or other items) with the member they belong to. Cursor pagination is available: pass next_cursor back as cursor. API: GET /v1/sales.

user_ids.description: Only sales of these member ids (max 100).

updated_after.description: Only sales updated at or after this datetime.

updated_before.description: Only sales updated at or before this datetime.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page. Send an empty string for the first cursor page; omit it to page by page number.

tools.name: fitdegree_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the studio's staff (team members): name, role fields and whether they are active. Use it to match instructors to sessions. API: GET /v1/team_members.

fitspot_id.description: Only staff of this fitspot id.

is_active.description: true = active staff only; false = inactive staff only.

updated_after.description: Only staff updated at or after this datetime.

updated_before.description: Only staff updated at or before this datetime.
